messages:
anya: Heads-up team LumenBridge case study interview locked for Thu Aug 14 11:00am PT. Deliverables: short launch post, 30s testimonial, product page quote, and optional joint webinar. Need quote + logo rights + metric approval by Tue Aug 12 EOD.

rachel: I'll draft PR copy and outreach. Can we ask them if they want an embargo? They mentioned syncing with a channel partner.

marco: I'll run recording and capture a 4k headshot frame for the hero. Will add chapter marks for 15s/30s/2m cuts.

devin: Legal note: any numeric metric requires a written approval line with signer and date. Request SVG logo and a short permission: "Approved for public release by LumenBridge, [date]". Route to legal@redwood.example. Avoid naming competitors in quotes.

anya: Draft quote to propose (please shorten/edit):
```
"Redwood let us serve live recommendations with predictable latency, unlocking faster product iteration."  Maya V., VP Engineering, LumenBridge
```
Thoughts?

marco: Fine but maybe swap "serve" -> "ship" for clarity. Shorter: "Redwood helped us ship live recommendations with predictable latency."

rachel: Good call. I'll send DM with the tightened quote and ask for the SVG plus metric permission. Also ask if they want co-hosted webinar. Template: > Hi Maya thanks again. Can you confirm the quote below and confirm we can use LumenBridge logo (SVG)? If you have a publishable metric please include exact wording and a line: "Approved for public release by LumenBridge, [date]". Also let us know if you want a joint webinar and whether we should embargo.

ops-bot: Calendar event created: "LumenBridge case study interview" Thu Aug 14 11:00am PT  Recording link: https://meet.redwood.example/lumenbridge-221

devin: Also request permission to use a 30s clip on our product page and a 15s social teaser. Need explicit sign-off for video usage.

anya: Timeline recap: send request today (Rachel); legal sign-off by Tue Aug 12 EOD (Devin); interview Thu Aug 14 (Marco); draft post + clips ready Fri Aug 15 for internal review. Flag any blockers.

marco: Will ensure local backup and separate audio track. Editors will get raw + marked chapters to /shared/marketing/lumenbridge after call.

rachel: DM sent to Maya. Pasting reply here when received.

(20m later)

rachel: Maya replied: "Approved the quote with minor edit: replace 'product iteration' with 'feature rollout'. Attaching SVG. We can publish a 22% decrease in median inference latency. Please include: 'Approved for public release by LumenBridge, Aug 11 2026.' Prefer embargo until Aug 20 to align with partner." Link to SVG: /shared/marketing/lumenbridge/logo.svg

devin: Received approval line. Legal sign-off logged. We'll require final copy before publish for a quick stamp. Add footer: "Approved for public release by LumenBridge, Aug 11 2026."

anya: Great  embargo set for Aug 20. Rachel, incorporate the 22% stat and the edited quote: 
"Redwood helped us ship live recommendations with predictable latency, unlocking faster feature rollout."  Maya V., VP Engineering, LumenBridge

marco: Editors note: include the 22% stat in a benchmark sidebar and timestamp where Maya mentions it. Upload clips and frames after recording.

rachel: I'll draft the post and the short webinar blurb: "Join LumenBridge + Redwood on Sep 2 for a short walk-through + Q&A." Will queue embargoed publish in CMS for Aug 20.

ops-bot: CMS embargo scheduled for Aug 20 09:00am PT; zap configured to tag leads with case_lumenbridge_launch at publish.

devin: Final legal step: quick review of the final PR copy before publish. Rachel please ping legal once the draft is ready.

anya: Thanks everyone. Action list: Rachel -> draft + schedule embargo; Marco -> record + upload clips; Devin -> final legal stamp; Ops -> confirm lead routing at publish. :thumbsup:
